migrations.name: 0001_legacy_credentials
up: CREATE TABLE legacy_credential_config (tenant_id uuid PRIMARY KEY, root_reference_id text NOT NULL CHECK (root_reference_id ~ '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,128}$'))

CREATE TABLE legacy_credential_subjects (tenant_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES legacy_credential_config (tenant_id), subject_id text NOT NULL CHECK (subject_id ~ '^[a-zA-Z0-9_-]{1,128}$'), token_prefix text NOT NULL CHECK (token_prefix ~ '^[a-z0-9_]{0,10}$'), PRIMARY KEY (tenant_id, subject_id))
ALTER TABLE legacy_credential_config ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
ALTER TABLE legacy_credential_config FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY

CREATE POLICY legacy_credential_config_tenant ON legacy_credential_config USING (tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true), '')::uuid) WITH CHECK (tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true), '')::uuid)
ALTER TABLE legacy_credential_subjects ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
ALTER TABLE legacy_credential_subjects FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY

CREATE POLICY legacy_credential_subjects_tenant ON legacy_credential_subjects USING (tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true), '')::uuid) WITH CHECK (tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true), '')::uuid)
REVOKE ALL ON legacy_credential_config, legacy_credential_subjects FROM PUBLIC

migrations.name: 0002_local_data_authentication
up: ALTER TABLE legacy_credential_config ADD COLUMN root_verifiers text[], ADD COLUMN verifier_root_reference_id text, ADD COLUMN root_version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (root_version>0)
ALTER TABLE legacy_credential_subjects ADD COLUMN verifiers text[], ADD COLUMN verifier_token_prefix text, ADD COLUMN credential_version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 CHECK (credential_version>0)

CREATE TABLE legacy_data_keys (tenant_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES legacy_credential_config(tenant_id), kid text NOT NULL CHECK (kid ~ '^[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$'), public_key text NOT NULL CHECK (length(public_key) BETWEEN 32 AND 8192), private_key text CHECK (length(private_key) BETWEEN 32 AND 8192), active boolean NOT NULL, signing boolean NOT NULL CHECK (NOT signing OR (active AND private_key IS NOT NULL)), PRIMARY KEY(tenant_id,kid))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX legacy_data_one_signer ON legacy_data_keys(tenant_id) WHERE signing
ALTER TABLE legacy_data_keys ENABLE ROW LEVEL SECURITY
ALTER TABLE legacy_data_keys FORCE ROW LEVEL SECURITY

CREATE POLICY legacy_data_keys_tenant ON legacy_data_keys USING (tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true), '')::uuid) WITH CHECK (tenant_id = nullif(current_setting('app.current_tenant_id', true), '')::uuid)
REVOKE ALL ON legacy_data_keys FROM PUBLIC
